messages:
Mia: Quick heads-up — planning to enable two kernel flags for a 5% canary on prod tomorrow 09:00 PST: `flash_attention_v2` and `speculative_decode_opt`. Need owners, rollback plan, and a short list of metrics/alerts to watch. cc @Aj @Kevin

Aj: Re KV-cache — does `speculative_decode_opt` change cache key shape? Last time we had a cache miss spike when we changed decoder path.

Kevin: Good catch. It shouldn't change key shape, but it does change decode timing. We should watch `kv_cache_hit_rate` and p50/p95 decode latency. Also watch `token_throughput_per_gpu`.

Sophia: Can we gate the spec-decode behind a per-model flag? i.e. only enable for small-medium models in the canary. Don't want Llama-70b doing speculative work.

Mia: Yes — plan is audience = 5% but only models with `size <= 13b`. I'll add that to canary config.

Kevin: Rollback plan: 1) flip off flags via admin UI or `redwoodctl feature set` 2) fallback route to previous kernel variant 3) scale down canary traffic immediately. Keep timeline: 09:00 enable, watch 30m, escalate at 15m if errors.

Aj: Ops ask: what are exact flag names so I can add guardrail monitors?

Mia: `runtime.flag.flash_attention_v2` and `runtime.flag.spec_decode_parallel`

DeployBot: Deploy plan created: canary=5% -> 09:00 PST -> rollout window 2h -> auto-rollback on error-rate>0.5% OR p95 latency increase > 40%. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/3482

OpsBot: Suggested alert thresholds:
- `error_rate` > 0.5% sustained 5m
- `spec_decode_retries` > 10/min
- `kv_cache_miss_rate` delta > +5pt vs baseline
- `p95_decode_latency` > baseline * 1.4

Sophia: Also add a synthetic prompt set: 10 prompts that exercise long-context + stops. If speculative decides early we need to ensure quality doesn't regress. I'll upload to evals repo by EOD.

Mia: Assigning owners: Mia = rollout lead, Aj = observability & alerts, Kevin = runtime rollback cadence + kernel fallback config, Sophia = quality/evals.

Aj: I'll add dashboards: one panel for `kv_cache_hit_rate` (by model), `p50/p95 decode latency`, `token_throughput_per_gpu`, and a small table of `user-facing error samples` from prod logs.

Kevin: Quick check: any model versions pinned? If customers pinned a model variant, we shouldn't flip flags for those.

Mia: Good point — canary will exclude any route with `pin:model=` metadata. I'll include that in rollout rules.

Aj: One more: include a shortplaybook in the deploy thread for how to manually disable flags via CLI:
```
# disable both flags
redwoodctl feature set runtime.flag.flash_attention_v2 false --scope canary
redwoodctl feature set runtime.flag.spec_decode_parallel false --scope canary
```

Mia: Perfect. If nobody objects I will schedule 09:00 PST tomorrow and add the playbook to the CI deploy. If problems appear we flip and open an incident. :thumbsup:

Kevin: :thumbsup:

Sophia: :raised_hands:

Aj: LGTM, will add alerts and the dashboard now.

Mia: Thanks team — I'll post final canary config in the deploy ticket once scheduled.
